chunks: Abū Baṣīr asked him about suhoor for one who intends to fast, saying: “Is it obligatory upon him?” So he said:
“There is no harm in his not taking suhoor, if he wishes. But in the Month of Ramaḍān, it is better that he take suhoor. I prefer that it not be abandoned in the Month of Ramaḍān.”

key_terms.السَّحُورِ: the pre-dawn meal taken before fasting
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the Month of Ramadan, the prescribed month of fasting
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or no objection

ai.seo_question: Is suhoor obligatory for fasting, especially in the Month of Ramadan?
ai.summary: This hadith states that suhoor is not obligatory for one intending to fast. However, in the Month of Ramaḍān, taking suhoor is better and preferred, and it is liked that one should not leave it.
